# Dylan Austin - Senior Content Designer & UX Writer

> Dylan Austin is a Senior Content Designer and UX Writer in Seattle with 10 years of experience specializing in accessible digital experiences, information architecture, and conversation design.

Dylan works at the intersection of UX writing and frontend prototyping, with a background shaping products at Pinterest and Ancestry. He specializes in simplifying high-friction digital spaces—turning dense operational logic, compliance matrices, and multi-user settings into clear, empathetic, and intuitive user experiences.

## Navigation

- [Home](/) - Portfolio overview and featured case studies.
- [About](/about) - Professional background, design philosophy, skills, and personal interests.

## Featured Projects & Case Studies

- [Roles & Permissions Feature](/projects/roles-and-permissions-feature/): Collaborative role-based access framework for Ancestry's 'Know Your Pet DNA' users.
- [Veterinary Intake & Service Architecture](/projects/veterinary-intake-and-service-architecture/): Speculative redesign including service architecture, FigJam flowcharts, user flows, and lo-fi conversational prototypes.
- [Jackery Solar Planner](/projects/jackery-solar-planner/): An interactive solar configuration tool featuring a live energy model and React prototype.

## Technical & Tooling Focus
- End-to-end design toolkit: Wireframing, high-fidelity prototyping, research synthesis.
- Systems & Tech: 11ty (Eleventy Excellent), CUBE CSS, JavaScript, WebC, and flat Markdown files. Hosted on Netlify with automated GitHub deployments and pa11y Accessibility Audits.
- Workflows: Integrates AI-assisted workflows into prototyping loops to stress-test microcopy variations and build functional models.
